parse.py.text:
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import sqlite3

root = pathlib.Path('/tmp/jstack-trace-unmapped-20261016')
source = pathlib.Path('/tmp/jstack-trace-input-20261016/unmapped.cpuprofile')
raw = source.read_bytes()
profile = json.loads(raw)
assert isinstance(profile, dict)
assert all(key in profile for key in ('nodes', 'samples', 'timeDeltas', 'startTime', 'endTime'))
nodes = profile['nodes']
samples = profile['samples']
deltas = profile['timeDeltas']
ids = [node['id'] for node in nodes]
assert len(ids) == len(set(ids))
assert len(samples) == len(deltas)
assert all(sample in ids for sample in samples)
assert all(isinstance(delta, (int, float)) and delta >= 0 for delta in deltas)
assert profile['endTime'] >= profile['startTime']
assert sum(deltas) <= profile['endTime'] - profile['startTime']
assert not (root / 'profile.sqlite').exists()
db = sqlite3.connect(root / 'profile.sqlite')
db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON')
schema = '''
CREATE TABLE artifact(path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha256 TEXT, raw_json TEXT);
CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, json_value TEXT);
CREATE TABLE nodes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, function_name TEXT, script_id TEXT, url TEXT, line_number INTEGER, column_number INTEGER, hit_count INTEGER, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE edges(parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES nodes(id), child_id INTEGER REFERENCES nodes(id), child_order INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(parent_id, child_order), UNIQUE(child_id));
CREATE TABLE samples(ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, node_id INTEGER REFERENCES nodes(id), delta_us REAL NOT NULL, timestamp_us REAL NOT NULL);
'''
(root / 'schema.sql').write_text(schema)
db.executescript(schema)
db.execute('INSERT INTO artifact VALUES (?,?,?)', (str(source), hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), raw.decode()))
for key, value in profile.items():
    if key not in ('nodes', 'samples', 'timeDeltas'):
        db.execute('INSERT INTO metadata VALUES (?,?)', (key, json.dumps(value)))
for node in nodes:
    frame = node['callFrame']
    db.execute('INSERT INTO nodes VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (node['id'], frame.get('functionName'), frame.get('scriptId'), frame.get('url'), frame.get('lineNumber'), frame.get('columnNumber'), node.get('hitCount'), json.dumps(node)))
for node in nodes:
    for order, child in enumerate(node.get('children', [])):
        assert child in ids
        db.execute('INSERT INTO edges VALUES (?,?,?)', (node['id'], child, order))
parents = {child: parent for parent, child in db.execute('SELECT parent_id,child_id FROM edges')}
for node_id in ids:
    seen = set()
    current = node_id
    while current in parents:
        assert current not in seen, 'Cycle in call tree'
        seen.add(current)
        current = parents[current]
timestamp = profile['startTime']
for ordinal, (node_id, delta) in enumerate(zip(samples, deltas)):
    timestamp += delta
    db.execute('INSERT INTO samples VALUES (?,?,?,?)', (ordinal, node_id, delta, timestamp))
db.commit()
assert db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM nodes').fetchone()[0] == len(nodes)
assert db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM samples').fetchone()[0] == len(samples)
assert json.loads(db.execute('SELECT raw_json FROM artifact').fetchone()[0]) == profile
assert [row[0] for row in db.execute('SELECT node_id FROM samples ORDER BY ordinal')] == samples
assert [row[0] for row in db.execute('SELECT delta_us FROM samples ORDER BY ordinal')] == deltas
assert db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall() == []
assert db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0] == 'ok'
print(json.dumps({'format': 'V8/DevTools CPU profile JSON', 'node_count': len(nodes), 'sample_count': len(samples), 'stored_without_dropped_records': True, 'sample_delta_units': 'microseconds', 'raw_round_trip': True, 'integrity': 'ok'}))
db.close()
